jobs.description_text: About the Organization Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets. About the Role Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this mission, we are seeking a Resource Efficiency Manager (REM) II to lead energy optimization efforts on-site at the customer’s Guam facilities, including Joint Region Marianas (JRM), Naval Base Guam (NBG), and Marine Corps Base (MCB) Guam. You will serve as a technical lead and mentor, managing a Level I REM while supporting the Installation Energy Manager (IEM) in executing high-priority energy programs. This is a high-impact opportunity to apply technical expertise to complex facility systems in a vital mission environment.

jobs.title: Associate Technical Consultant - Entry-Level Consulting
jobs.description_text: Do you love technology but want to do more than just code?
